Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a mass in the right lower lung zone (indicated by the arrow) that appears to abut or involve the chest wall/breast region. In the context of clinical history often associated with such questions, a mass in this location is frequently a metastasis from a primary lung tumor extending to the chest wall or breast, rather than a primary breast carcinoma which would typically present differently on imaging.
